recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, grainy photograph of a person with curly blonde hair viewed from behind, wearing a red and white leather jacket that mimics cigarette packaging graphics. The subject stands behind a blue pointed picket fence against a clear blue sky with utility lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed between blue fence and blue sky
Red jacket acts as the primary focal point and color pop
Utility lines create diagonal tension against the vertical subject
Textured film grain unifies the disparate color blocks
coreInvariants: High-saturation primary color palette (Red, Blue, White)
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Sharp geometric division on the jacket back

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white chevron shape on the back of the red jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the blue fence at the bottom, up the red jacket to the blonde hair, then following the utility lines into the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue sky in the upper half providing breathing room for the busy textures below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue (sky and fence) providing a cool backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (jacket) creating immediate visual impact.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white (jacket graphic) and golden blonde (hair).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors with crushed blacks in the shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned characters to fit within the white geometric field

composition.warp: slight contour following the jacket fabric

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum graphic impact, paired with standard metadata blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, sharp aesthetic of the original lettering.
Provides the necessary verticality and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a man with curly blonde hair from behind, wearing a red leather jacket with a large white chevron panel on the back. He is standing behind a blue wooden picket fence. The background is a clear blue sky with a wooden utility pole and wires. Apply heavy 35mm film grain and high saturation.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place condensed high-contrast serif text in black, centered within the white chevron area of the jacket. Ensure the text follows the slight folds of the leather.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across the sky and subject?
Does the red of the jacket pop against the blue sky?
Is the text centered within the white geometric shape?
Are the utility lines visible but not distracting?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue for the sky
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic leather texture on the jacket
Ensure the blue fence has a 'painted wood' texture
Verify the sky has no digital gradients, only grain
Confirm the text looks printed on the jacket, not floating
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle perspective + Primary color blocking + High-contrast Serif + Heavy Film Grain = Suburban Americana Aesthetic
